localChanges: Civilizations that looked alike now have colours of their own, so they're easy to tell apart on the map: Egypt, Mongolia, China and Rome are no longer all red, Germany is now mostly gold trimmed in black, France is blue rather than sharing white with England, and Rome is purple and gold (closes #540).
